review_type: Parallel specialist authoring plus separate root editorial/arithmetic/instructional audit and a bounded agent peer review of root c01; internal review, not external academic certification

reviewed.reasoning: Root read all four manuscripts, exercise/solution pairs and executable laboratory sources. Audited composite release keys, latest-eligible date selection, complete-period availability, price-base units and flow aggregation; spreadsheet copy coordinates and NPV time-zero/empty-period conventions, full/partial working-capital recovery, independently sourced balances versus canceled errors, scenario conditioning and break-even signs. Reviewed beginner Python syntax ordering, pure functions/aliasing, int-cent versus float-PV precision, integer basis-point rates, finite implementation bounds, explicit schema/unit/duplicate/type guards and assert removal. Reviewed array shape versus label alignment, report/household grain, join multiplicities and outer-filter timing, NULL/zero/absent-report distinctions, consistent weighted denominators, regional versus household means, panel coverage and UTC half-open intervals.
reviewed.arithmetic: Root independently traced all worked and exercise arithmetic before running the submitted checkers. Recomputed vintage sums and deflator relationships, discounted-flow timelines and sensitivity slope/intercept, bank residual direction, order-margin totals and basis-point discounting, join row counts, population/weight denominators and cross-boundary event membership. Integrated and executed four checkers: exact Fraction calculations and all 720 release-row permutations; actual manuscript sensitivity formula translated/evaluated across nine cells versus separate revenue/payment decomposition; 49 exact NPV references plus wrong-input/optimized-mode CLI and displayed-code tests; 94 SQL-versus-independent-Python, date, key, NULL, array and rejection checks.
reviewed.solutions: Read all 32 original exercises and full solutions against their exact prompts. Confirmed missing-quarter failure versus partial coverage, duplicate-vintage excess percentage denominator, effective-deflator harmonic identity and provenance critique criteria. Checked omitted-zero-year timing, partial terminal recovery, mixed-reference copying, scenario thresholds and periodic-rate conventions. Checked printed versus returned values and list mutations, signed margins, exact/rounded NPV and explicit failure patterns. Checked roster-versus-report counts, zero replacement, many-to-many multiplication, EXISTS preservation, timezone membership and panel denominator critique. Open audit/causal/verification questions include concrete evaluation criteria.
reviewed.instruction: Chapter1 teaches provenance and inputs; Chapter2 uses those principles in cell models; Chapter3 teaches the programming syntax needed to build calculations; Chapter4 adds arrays, tables and SQL. Audited prerequisites and added first-use explanations for sets, comprehensions, generator expressions, singleton tuples and finally in Chapter4. Code-writing is not required before the beginner programming chapter; earlier downloads supply optional independently inspectable calculations. Each chapter has two worked examples, eight solved exercises, assumptions/units/boundaries, teach-back and delayed check.
reviewed.sources: Merged 28 method-specific entries proposed by the authors after checking each entry against cited IDs, exact primary routes and scoped retrieval claims: AEA/FRED/Git/hashlib; official Microsoft references/NPV; official Python core/stdlib; official SQLite SQL/types/constraints/dates and Python array/sqlite/datetime. Agent retrieval records distinguish inspected semantics from full-page verification and historical point-release claims. Original synthetic observations, cash flows, households, exercises and code are explicitly labeled. No source implies institutional approval or validates example forecasts.
reviewed.structure: Integrated all four chapter checkers into scripts/verify.py and added an acceptance gate requiring accepted prerequisites. First full batch build/verification passed: 40 available chapters and 48 HTML pages, no local-link/anchor/source-ID/structure errors. Project downloads use the builder actual flat output layout. New source and chapter statuses are reviewed before dependency-ordered acceptance; completed Volumes1–3 remain intact. Visual/mobile/print UI checks remain pending under the recorded browser-policy restriction.

corrections: Root initially told agents to use a projects/ URL prefix; code inspection showed the build copies artifacts to dist root. All four chapters corrected to flat download names before the successful integrated check.
Root review found Chapter4 incorrectly named simulation as its immediate successor; corrected to Chapter5 visualization.
Root review required first-use explanations of Python syntax beyond Chapter3, avoiding hidden prerequisites in Chapter4.
Root review found year formatting could break canonical timestamp comparisons for years below1000; Chapter4 now uses fixed ISO output and validates numeric offset ranges.

A separate specialist peer review found root Chapter1 only rejected releases before the first day of the month, despite a completed-month data contract. Root changed the guard to month-end, documented the forecast distinction and added a defect rejection check; supplied results unchanged.
limitations: Internal author/coordinator/agent peer review is not independent human academic review or learner testing.
Each numerical laboratory is a bounded original synthetic case; passing arithmetic and execution checks does not validate empirical inputs, economic forecasts or causal identification.
Financial-model formula translation and Python reference checks do not include actual Excel/LibreOffice recalculation; no workbook application or GUI was tested.
Software source documents were inspected for specified established methods, not archived or verified as exact historical point releases.
Visual/mobile/print browser QA remains pending after the prior security-policy rejection.
Volume4 Chapters5–12 and its full volume package, remaining volumes and cross-volume terminal requirements are unfinished.
acceptance: Accepted by root after full manuscript, solution, primary-source, instruction and executable review plus successful integrated checks. All four accepted in prerequisite order. This is a coherent opening batch, not a complete Volume4 or complete library.
